strengths: Most body prose is calm magazine feature tone with concrete scenes
Closing contrast (visitor quirk vs local end-of-street) is clear without exoticizing

issues.problem: ‘Many visitors to Japan notice one unusual thing.’ is stock AI/travel-template phrasing shared with sibling Everyday Japan articles
issues.suggestion: Open on a specific threshold scene (shoes lined at a restaurant step, genkan rack) without the generic ‘unusual thing’ frame

issues.problem: ‘A foreign visitor sees… / A local sees…’ is slightly formulaic parallel rhetoric
issues.suggestion: Keep the insight but vary the cadence so it feels less like a template closer
